reference_position_published.source: Camilo et al. 2006, ApJ 637, 456 (PSR J1833-1034 Parkes timing); confirmed by Bietenholz & Bartel 2008, MNRAS 386, 1411 (VLBA).

measurement_method: WCS-aware aperture photometry: source = sum within fk5 circle r=30" of the published PSR J1833-1034 position; background = sigma-clipped median in fk5 annulus 100"-150". Equivalent to DS9 Analysis>Funtools>funcnts on the same regions.
scoring_policy: RA/Dec accepted if great-circle separation from gold centroid <= 2.0 arcsec; net_counts accepted if within +/-15 percent of gold value.
